race.comment: PRINCE OF LOVE (2) scored two back at Griffith but was below his best last time when ninth over 1400m at Jerilderie. It doesn't get any easier but on his best form he is one of the chief contenders. DITA VON (11) is closing in on a win, last time out finishing third over 1150m at Leeton when just 1.2 lengths from the winner. Has a good gate and is expected to feature. SIMONE'S CHOICE (10) looks close to a win, finishing in the placings at her last couple of runs including a second most recently over 1150m at Leeton when beaten a neck. Has the pace and the right draw to find a good early position. Will give backers a great sight. PRINCE RUPERT (1) is in with an each-way chance.,
